summary: AI4Scholar for DeepSeek Harness adds academic literature tools that connect to AI4Scholar-backed sources like Semantic Scholar, PubMed, and arXiv for paper search, metadata lookup, full-text access, and citation support.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily an external-academic-service integration for DeepSeek Harness: the README describes 38 built-in tools for scholarly search, paper metadata/detail retrieval, citation graph queries, DOI/full-text access, and citation/figure helpers, with configuration and execution tied to a DSH plugin row (`ai4scholar`) and API key resolution. The package export and dependency setup confirm it is a dsh web plugin plus client-side settings card, so user impact is research/tooling access rather than local code execution.
